meta.title: Download the Desktop App | MAULT
meta.description: Download the MAULT desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Scanning keeps running in the background, with a floating preview, taskbar controls and desktop notifications.

hero.title: Keep sorting while you do something else
hero.description: The MAULT desktop app is the full web app in its own window. Scanning keeps running when it is minimized or behind other apps, and a floating preview keeps the sorter in view.
hero.alreadyInstalled: You are already using the desktop app. It keeps itself up to date, so there is nothing to download.
hero.note: Free, signs in with your existing MAULT account, and installs updates on its own.

platforms.title: Pick your platform
platforms.description: Every link is the latest version. Once installed, the app updates itself.

features.title: Built for long sorting sessions
features.description: A browser pauses tabs it can't see. The desktop app keeps the sorter running and lets you watch it from anywhere on your screen.

items.title: Scans in the background
items.description: Minimize the window or cover it with other apps and the sorter keeps scanning and routing cards.

items.title: Floating preview
items.description: When MAULT goes into the background, a small always-on-top window shows the camera, status, card count and timer, with play, pause, auto-feed and drop all controls.

items.title: Taskbar controls
items.description: On Windows, hover the taskbar icon to pause, resume, toggle auto-feed or drop all without opening the app.

items.title: Desktop notifications
items.description: Errors and warnings show up as system notifications while you are working in another app.

items.title: Always up to date
items.description: The app always loads the latest MAULT and installs desktop updates in the background.

install.title: Installing the app
install.description: Some platforms ask for an extra click the first time you open it.

windows.title: Windows
windows.body: Run MAULT-windows.exe. If Windows SmartScreen says it protected your PC, choose More info, then Run anyway. MAULT opens when it finishes and adds a Start menu shortcut.

macos.title: macOS
macos.body: Open MAULT-macos.dmg and drag MAULT into Applications. If macOS says it can't check the app, right-click MAULT in Applications and choose Open.

linux.title: Linux
linux.body: Make the file executable with chmod +x MAULT-linux.AppImage, then run it. To connect a sorter over USB, your user may need to be in the dialout group.
